Changes: rewritten in plain wiki text without Lua (Module:Article stub box): a one-cell table; "You can help Wikipedia" names the board instead ({{SITENAME}}); no image, no link to the edit page, no v t e links, no category options; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{Asbox|subject=software|name=Template:Software-stub}}
Expect: This software article is a stub. You can help {{SITENAME}} by adding missing information.
Example: {{Asbox|name=Template:X-stub}}
Expect: This article is a stub. You can help {{SITENAME}} by adding missing information.
